teachers.qualifications: B.Ed (Arts), Dip. Educational Management & Institutional Governance
teachers.specialization: School Vision, Holistic Mentorship & Community Development
teachers.biography: Director Constance Mwaka Pole is a visionary educational champion celebrated throughout Mazeras and Kilifi County for establishing an inclusive, morals-driven sanctuary of learning. Her transformative leadership, unwavering dedication to child safeguarding, and passionate commitment to academic distinction continue to empower hundreds of young scholars to realize their fullest divine and academic potential.
teachers.commendation: Visionary founder and pillar of Amani Junior Academy, transforming education in Mazeras with profound integrity, selfless devotion, and motherly compassion.
teachers.philosophy: Every child is endowed with divine promise; our highest calling is to nurture it with unconditional love, discipline, and uncompromising academic standards.

teachers.qualifications: B.Ed (Sc), Higher Dip. Quality Assurance & Standards in Education
teachers.specialization: CBC Curriculum Alignment, Teacher Mentorship & Examinations Quality
teachers.biography: Headteacher Nadhiri Chacha Salim is an esteemed educational administrator renowned for his rigorous standards of instructional delivery, gentle firmness in student discipline, and relentless pursuit of pedagogical excellence. He works hand-in-hand with parents and teachers to cultivate an orderly, joyful, and high-performing learning environment.
teachers.commendation: Steadfast custodian of academic discipline, instructional quality, and Kenya Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC) compliance.
teachers.philosophy: Discipline and structured effort are the golden bridges between a student’s raw potential and lifelong scholastic accomplishment.

teachers.position: Deputy Headteacher & Head of Academics / ICT
teachers.qualifications: B.Sc Computer Science & Education, Certified CBC Master Facilitator
teachers.specialization: In Charge of Academics, Curriculum Delivery, Examinations, Computer Studies & Science
teachers.biography: Teacher Vitalice Odhiambo is the distinguished Deputy Headteacher and Head of Academics, in direct charge of academic standards, timetable coordination, curriculum delivery, diagnostic assessments, and digital integration across all tiers of the academy. Praised by parents and colleagues for his dynamic teaching methods, unmatched dedication to pupil performance, and visionary coding curriculum, he ensures every learner achieves academic brilliance and technological confidence.
teachers.commendation: The academic heartbeat of Amani Junior Academy & JSS. In charge of Academics, Teacher Vitalice Odhiambo leads with extraordinary diligence, orchestrating timetable precision, stellar academic results, and pioneering digital education.
teachers.philosophy: Through clear academic structure, disciplined study habits, and hands-on digital empowerment, no student will ever be left behind.

teachers.biography: Madam Gladys brings radiant enthusiasm and joyful energy into every lesson. A champion of motor agility and creative exploration, she helps learners observe nature, express themselves freely through drama and music, and embrace physical health from an early age.
teachers.commendation: A radiant educator whose infectious enthusiasm for music and nature unlocks children’s imagination and physical confidence.
teachers.philosophy: Curiosity nurtured with warm encouragement in the early years blossoms into lifelong academic distinction.

teachers.specialization: PP2 Phonics Reading, Writing Readiness & Numeracy
teachers.biography: Teacher Emily Mwaka is a revered reading specialist praised for turning PP2 learners into astonishingly fluent, confident early readers. Her meticulous phonics workshops and warm encouragement ensure that every pupil graduates to Grade 1 with superior literacy and numeracy foundations.
teachers.commendation: A revered phonics master celebrated for transforming PP2 learners into astonishingly fluent, confident early readers ready for Grade 1.
teachers.philosophy: When a child learns to read with joy and ease, the doors of every academic discipline are unlocked for life.

teachers.qualifications: P1 Primary Teacher Certificate, CBC Trained Facilitator
teachers.biography: Madam Florence is an outstanding pillar of Lower Primary education, admired for her kind motherly composure and dedication to individualized learner support. She transforms complex early arithmetic into intuitive daily adventures and nurtures impeccable penmanship.
teachers.commendation: An esteemed Lower Primary matriarch whose calm clarity turns first-grade arithmetic and penmanship into a daily triumph for every child.
teachers.philosophy: Patience, structure, and warm praise awaken the dormant brilliance in every student.

teachers.specialization: Daycare & Playgroup Nurturing, Socialization & Sensory Play
teachers.biography: Madam Raheli Wali is cherished for her boundless maternal warmth, angelic patience, and exceptional gift in comforting young toddlers taking their very first steps away from home. Her playful, affirming classroom atmosphere transforms school into a safe haven of laughter, wonder, and emotional security.
teachers.commendation: A gentle mother to our youngest learners whose tender care dissolves all first-day tears and fills toddlers with boundless confidence and joy.
teachers.philosophy: To teach a toddler is to touch the future with tenderness, boundless patience, and unconditional affection.

teachers.specialization: Playgroup Activities, Fine Motor Skills & Pre-Literacy
teachers.biography: Madam Tatu is a master of imaginative early learning, admired for bringing stories and rhymes alive through colorful puppetry, sensory exploration, and joyful song. She effortlessly instills confidence, verbal articulacy, and cheerful camaraderie in our youngest learners.
teachers.commendation: A spark of imaginative wonder who turns early childhood into an enchanting world of songs, motor coordination, and joyful learning.
teachers.philosophy: Joyful, hands-on play is the highest form of foundational research for a growing child.

teachers.qualifications: Dip. Early Childhood Education (KICD CBC Certified)
teachers.biography: Madam Periz Inyangala is an exceptional pre-primary educator celebrated for laying rock-solid foundations in letter sounds, numeracy, and cooperative team values. Her gentle guidance and structured sensory centers inspire deep curiosity and lifelong self-confidence in little scholars.
teachers.commendation: A cornerstone of foundational literacy, revered by parents for giving PP1 children rock-solid phonetic clarity and numeric confidence.
teachers.philosophy: A solid, affirming beginning creates an unstoppable lifelong scholar.

teachers.biography: Madam Halima is a gifted linguist and cultural storyteller whose vibrant Kiswahili sessions inspire children to speak eloquently and embrace coastal heritage. Her outdoor environmental explorations instill respect for living things and community responsibility.
teachers.commendation: Master custodian of Kiswahili eloquence and cultural dignity, inspiring rich oration and reverence for the natural environment.
teachers.philosophy: Lugha safi ni uti wa mgongo wa hekima, maadili mema na utambulisho wa mwanafunzi.

teachers.biography: Mr. Elias is celebrated for his vibrant, interactive teaching style that turns mathematics into an exhilarating quest. He excels at sparking scientific inquiry in Grade 2 learners and is an inspiring mentor who teaches discipline, courage, and teamwork through Junior Scouts.
teachers.commendation: Dynamic mathematics mentor and Junior Scouts leader whose high-energy lessons make problem-solving and scientific discovery exhilarating.
teachers.philosophy: Mathematical confidence and personal character discipline go hand in hand to build champions.

teachers.biography: Madam Jessicah Chizi is a phenomenal creative arts instructor and choir director whose passion inspires extraordinary public speaking poise and artistic flair in Grade 3 learners. Under her mentorship, pupils develop rich vocabularies, expressive writing, and stage confidence.
teachers.commendation: Brilliant creative arts visionary and choir director whose pupils shine with exceptional poise, expressive English, and award-winning harmonies.
teachers.philosophy: Creative expression, music, and spoken eloquence give our children the courage to lead anywhere in the world.

teachers.specialization: Grade 4 Social Studies, Christian Religious Education & Agriculture
teachers.biography: Madam Nancy is an inspiring educator celebrated for shaping moral uprightness, civic integrity, and hands-on agricultural mastery in Grade 4. Her active 4-K club gardens give pupils practical farming skills, environmental stewardship, and nutritional consciousness.
teachers.commendation: Exemplary agricultural champion and moral mentor cultivating lush green school gardens and integrity in Grade 4 leaders.
teachers.philosophy: Work with your hands, guard your moral character, and learn to steward the earth responsibly.

teachers.biography: Mr. Josephat Kobe is an energetic, highly disciplined mathematics and sports mentor who instills intellectual tenacity and athletic excellence in Grade 5 pupils. His mathematical problem-solving drills and championship soccer training inspire focus, resilience, and victory.
teachers.commendation: A powerhouse educator and athletics champion who builds razor-sharp mathematical thinkers and resilient sports champions.
teachers.philosophy: A sharp, critical intellect thrives best inside a disciplined, active, and determined body.

teachers.qualifications: B.Ed (Arts - English Literature & Social Sciences), First Class Honours
teachers.specialization: Grade 7 Junior Secondary English, Literature & Humanities
teachers.biography: Madam Rhoda Sikuku is an intellectually dazzling Junior Secondary literature specialist and debate coach holding First Class Honours. She challenges adolescents to think critically, express perspectives with persuasive eloquence, and excel in national CBC assessment benchmarks.
teachers.commendation: First-Class Honours academic luminary and debate patron driving our Junior Secondary scholars to elite national CBC distinction.
teachers.philosophy: Empower young minds to question deeply, reason logically, and articulate their convictions with unshakeable dignity.

assignments.title: Integrated Science: Laboratory Safety & Apparatus Classification
assignments.description: Sketch and categorize 5 basic laboratory instruments (Bunsen burner, beaker, test tube, measuring cylinder, tripod stand) and explain safety precautions when heating liquids.
assignments.instructions:
1. Prepare diagrams neatly on ruled foolscap or submit digital document.
2. State two immediate first aid procedures for minor acid spills.
3. Keep your write-up within 350 words.

assignments.title: Computer Science: Introduction to Python Variables & Data Types
assignments.description: Write Python pseudo-code to calculate the perimeter and area of a school vegetable garden. Identify the integer and float variables used.
assignments.instructions: Submit either your .py file or written logic explaining how inputs are captured from the user.

assignments.title: English Language: Narrative Composition on Environmental Conservation
assignments.description: Write a gripping 250-word narrative starting with: "As the morning mist lifted over Mazeras hills, our school eco-warriors assembled at the gate..."
assignments.instructions: Focus on descriptive sensory adjectives, correct punctuation, and imaginative character portrayal.

chatbotKnowledge.question: Where is Amani Junior Academy and JSS located?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: Amani Junior Academy and JSS is located in Mazeras, Kilifi County, Kenya (along the Mombasa-Nairobi corridor). Our official postal address is P.O. BOX 93-80114, MAZERAS, KENYA.

chatbotKnowledge.question: What is the school motto and philosophy?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: Our official school motto is "STRIVE TO ACHIEVE". We are committed to nurturing holistic academic excellence, moral integrity, technological literacy, and creative leadership in every learner.

chatbotKnowledge.question: Who are the school leaders and what are their phone numbers?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: Our School Director is CONSTANCE MWAKA POLE (Phone: 0718540922). Our Headteacher is NADHIRI CHACHA SALIM (Phone: 0114623408). Our Deputy Headteacher & ICT Lead is VITALICE ODHIAMBO.

chatbotKnowledge.question: What classes and grades does Amani offer?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: Amani Junior Academy and JSS offers comprehensive CBC education across: 1. Early Years / Pre-Primary (PP1 & PP2), 2. Primary School (Grade 1 through Grade 6), and 3. Junior Secondary School (Grade 7, Grade 8, and Grade 9 JSS). Admissions are currently ongoing.

chatbotKnowledge.question: What curriculum and facilities does the school have?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: We deliver Kenya's Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC) enriched with a modern ICT Computer & Coding Lab, Integrated Science Practical Stations, Creative Arts, Agricultural demonstration gardens, and spacious sports grounds.

chatbotKnowledge.question: What is the school fees structure?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: School fees at Amani Junior Academy and JSS are structured per grade level (Early Years, Primary, and JSS). To receive our official approved fee structure, please click "Admission Enquiry" or contact Director Constance Mwaka Pole at 0718540922.
